en.description:
Cast, wait for the bite, reel in the fish: Fishing Break is a little fishing game for iPhone and Apple Watch that fits into any coffee break.

A round takes a minute or two. The lake changes with the time of day, the weather and the seasons, and so does what's biting.

HOW IT WORKS
• Cast: with a tap or a flick, of your wrist on the watch or of the whole phone on iPhone. Hold a little longer to cast up to 100 m, where rare fish bite more often.
• Wait: a light twitch is just a nibble. Strike only when the float goes under and it vibrates strongly.
• Reel in: swipe on iPhone, turn the Digital Crown on the watch. Every detent clicks like a real reel.
• When the fish pulls, ease off or the line snaps. The edge of the screen shows how tight it is: the tighter the line, the narrower your view. When the fish is calm, reel it in before it gets away.

WHAT'S BITING?
• 66 catches in six rarity tiers, from roach to pike and catfish to legends nobody will believe. Plus more than 50 rare variants.
• Some species only show up at certain times of day, in certain weather or in one season. Who bites when is for you to find out.
• Not everything on the hook is a fish. Old boots are part of it.
• The rarer the catch, the shorter the window to strike and the harder the fight.

YOUR CATCH LOG
• Every species you discover goes into the catch log, with count, record, time of day and weather.
• iPhone and watch share one catch log.
• On the watch, complications show your catches right on the watch face.
• Widgets on iPhone and watch show who might be biting right now.

CATCH PHOTOS
• On iPhone you can take a photo of your catch: your own character holding the fish, at the lake as it looks right now. Share the photo or save it.
• If one gets away, you still get the photo, with a generously estimated length.
• You put your character together yourself, from hairstyle to glasses. Hats and outfits are sold for thalers in the Market Shop.
• During a market day, your character sends a postcard from wherever you're selling.

FISH MARKET
• On iPhone you can sell your catches and slowly build up a small business. You pick the place, stall, prices and fish, while weather, freshness and regulars have their say.
• A market day runs in real time, from half an hour with friends to six hours for New York.
• Friends and the Lake Stand are free. Every two weeks a collector comes to the lake.
• If you only want to fish, you won't notice the market at all.

SHOP
The game is free and has no ads. If you like, upgrade once in the iPhone app:
• Exotics Book: identifies unknown catches, including the ones you've already made.
• Carbon Rod: reels in faster, and the line takes more strain.
• Premium Bait: attracts more rare fish and less junk.
• Fish Market: the Village Market, City Market, the monthly Fish Festival and New York, plus the whole Market Shop and the Ledger.
Purchases are yours to keep and also apply on your Apple Watch. There's no subscription and nothing that runs out, and thalers are never sold for real money.

Fishing Break needs no account and no internet connection to play. The watch app also runs without your iPhone nearby.
en.releaseNotes:
New in 3.4:
• The shop is new: each upgrade is a note pinned up in front of your lake, with a picture and a list of what it gives you. What you already own gets a stamp.
• Your character gets four head shapes and six new hairstyles, such as a side part, a quiff or slicked-back hair. You'll find them in the Wardrobe, and the dice know them too. A character you've already made stays as it is.
• Tap Save to keep changes to your character, or Cancel to leave it as it was. Your character stays in view while you scroll through hairstyles and hats.
• The catch photo slides out like an instant photo and slowly develops.
• In the photos, hats and sleeves sit better, and hands and boots are redrawn.
• In the Catch Log you can now also take a photo with a variant you've caught.
• Photos can now be shared to WhatsApp, where sending used to get stuck.
• The catch card now shows the fish in color, just like the Catch Log. The photo button sits below it and no longer covers any text. With large text, the line with rarity, length and weight fits on the card again.

All your existing catches are kept. Tight lines!
en.subtitle: A quick little fishing game

ja.description:
Auswerfen, auf den Biss warten, den Fisch einholen: Angel-Pause ist ein kleines Angelspiel für iPhone und Apple Watch, das in jede Kaffeepause passt.

Eine Runde dauert ein, zwei Minuten. Der See ändert sich mit Tageszeit, Wetter und Jahreszeit, und mit ihm ändert sich, was anbeißt.

SO GEHT’S
• Auswerfen: per Tippen oder mit einem Schwung, auf der Watch aus dem Handgelenk, auf dem iPhone mit dem ganzen Gerät. Hältst du länger gedrückt, wirfst du bis zu 100 m weit. Dort beißt öfter etwas Seltenes.
• Abwarten: Leichtes Zucken ist nur Anknabbern. Erst wenn der Schwimmer abtaucht und es kräftig vibriert, schlägst du an.
• Einholen: auf dem iPhone per Wischen, auf der Watch mit der Digital Crown. Jede Raste klickt wie an einer echten Rolle.
• Zieht der Fisch, lass locker, sonst reißt die Schnur. Wie straff sie ist, siehst du am Bildschirmrand: Je straffer, desto enger wird der Blick. Ist der Fisch ruhig, hol ihn ein, bevor er entwischt.

WAS BEISST AN?
• 66 Fänge in sechs Seltenheitsstufen, vom Rotauge über Hecht und Wels bis zu Legenden, die dir keiner glaubt. Dazu über 50 seltene Varianten.
• Manche Arten kommen nur zu bestimmten Tageszeiten, bei bestimmtem Wetter oder in einer Jahreszeit. Wer wann beißt, findest du selbst heraus.
• Nicht alles am Haken ist ein Fisch. Auch alte Stiefel gehören dazu.
• Je seltener der Fang, desto kürzer das Zeitfenster beim Biss und desto härter der Drill.

DEIN FANGBUCH
• Jede Art, die du entdeckst, landet im Fangbuch, mit Anzahl, Rekord, Tageszeit und Wetter.
• iPhone und Watch teilen sich ein Fangbuch.
• Auf der Watch zeigen Komplikationen deine Fänge direkt auf dem Zifferblatt.
• Widgets auf iPhone und Watch zeigen, wer gerade beißen könnte.

FANGFOTOS
• Auf dem iPhone machst du von deinem Fang ein Foto: deine eigene Figur mit dem Fisch, am See so, wie er gerade aussieht. Das Foto kannst du teilen oder sichern.
• Reißt dir einer ab, gibt es das Foto trotzdem, mit großzügig geschätzter Länge.
• Deine Figur stellst du dir selbst zusammen, von der Frisur bis zur Brille. Hüte und Outfits gibt es im Marktladen für Taler.
• Während eines Markttags schickt deine Figur eine Postkarte von dort, wo du gerade verkaufst.

FISCHMARKT
• Auf dem iPhone kannst du deine Fänge verkaufen und dir nach und nach ein kleines Geschäft aufbauen. Ort, Stand, Preise und Fische suchst du selbst aus, Wetter, Frische und Stammkunden reden mit.
• Ein Markttag läuft in echter Zeit, von einer halben Stunde bei Freunden bis zu sechs Stunden für New York.
• Freunde und der Stand am See sind kostenlos. Alle zwei Wochen kommt ein Sammler an den See.
• Wer nur angeln will, bekommt vom Markt nichts mit.

LADEN
Das Spiel ist kostenlos und ohne Werbung. Wer mag, rüstet in der iPhone-App einmalig auf:
• Exoten-Buch: bestimmt unbekannte Fänge, auch die, die du schon gemacht hast.
• Carbon-Angel: holt schneller ein, und die Schnur hält mehr aus.
• Edelköder: lockt mehr seltene Fische an und weniger Schrott.
• Fischmarkt: Dorfmarkt, Stadtmarkt, das monatliche Fischfest und New York, dazu der ganze Marktladen und das Kassenbuch.
Die Käufe gelten auf Dauer und auch auf der Apple Watch. Es gibt kein Abo und nichts, was sich verbraucht. Taler gibt es nie für echtes Geld.

Angel-Pause braucht kein Konto und zum Spielen keine Internetverbindung. Die Watch-App läuft auch ohne iPhone in der Nähe.
ja.releaseNotes:
Neu in 3.4:
• Der Laden ist neu: Jedes Upgrade hängt als Zettel vor deinem See, mit Bild und einer Liste, was es dir bringt. Was du schon hast, bekommt einen Stempel.
• Deine Figur bekommt vier Kopfformen und sechs neue Frisuren, vom Seitenscheitel über die Tolle bis zum Haarkranz. Du findest sie im Kleiderschrank, und der Würfel kennt sie auch. Eine Figur, die du schon hast, bleibt, wie sie ist.
• Änderungen an der Figur übernimmst du mit Speichern, mit Abbrechen bleibt sie, wie sie war. Beim Blättern durch Frisuren und Hüte bleibt die Figur im Bild.
• Das Fangfoto kommt wie bei einer Sofortbildkamera aus dem Schlitz und entwickelt sich langsam.
• Auf den Fotos sitzen Hüte und Ärmel besser, Hände und Stiefel sind neu gezeichnet.
• Im Fangbuch kannst du jetzt auch ein Foto mit einer Variante machen, die du gefangen hast.
• Fotos lassen sich jetzt auch über WhatsApp teilen. Dort blieb das Senden bisher hängen.
• Die Fangkarte zeigt den Fisch jetzt in Farbe, so wie das Fangbuch. Der Foto-Knopf sitzt darunter und verdeckt keinen Text mehr. Bei großer Schrift passt die Zeile mit Seltenheit, Länge und Gewicht wieder ganz auf die Karte.

Alle bisherigen Fänge bleiben erhalten. Petri Heil!

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
New in 1.1:
• 13 new catches: bleak, tench, grayling and Danube salmon in the lake, plus goldfish, crab, jellyfish, turtle, electric eel, anglerfish, arapaima, ocean sunfish and an old phone in the Exotics Book.
• iPhone and Apple Watch now share one catch log. Your existing catches from both devices are combined.
• You can now cast and strike with a flick on iPhone too. You can turn this off in the catch log.

New in 2.0:
• A new lake: light moves smoothly through the day, the sun and moon cross the sky, and the water reflects it all. The moon shows its real phase.
• Lake weather: rain, fog, wind, thunderstorms and snow change twice a day.
• 21 new species in two free chapters: “Lake Times” and “Lake Weather & Moon”.
• 47 rare variants, from the mirror carp to the albino catfish.
• Every catch redrawn, with its own silhouette and hints. Lose a fish in the fight and you’ve at least spotted it.
• A catch diary for every species: first catch, record, length, time of day and weather.
• Over 100 new lines for regulars. The more often they bite, the chattier they get.
• With the Exotics Book, messages in a bottle now bring letters. Some only turn up on special days.
• New widget for iPhone and Apple Watch: it shows who might be biting right now.

All your existing catches are kept.

Thank you for downloading Fishing Break or giving it a try. Tight lines!

New in 2.1:
• Every fish bites its own way: some hesitate, some fidget, some warily drag the float aside. Strike when it goes under – not before.
• Every fish fights its own way: pike jump, catfish dive deep, carp make long runs, eels wriggle. You can feel it on iPhone and Apple Watch.
• New free chapter “Seasons” with eight catches, including two that only turn up at Easter and Christmas.
• The lake shows the season: blossom in spring, dragonflies in summer, leaves in autumn, snow and ice in winter. Sunrise and sunset follow the date, and in the southern hemisphere everything is shifted by half a year.
• Four new variants and the achievement “Year After Year”.

All your existing catches are kept. Tight lines!

New in 3.0:
• Fish Market: on iPhone you can now sell your catches and slowly build up a small business. You pick the place, stall, prices and fish, while weather, freshness and regulars have their say. A market day runs in real time, half an hour with friends and six hours for New York. If you like, the app lets you know when it's over.
• Friends and the Lake Stand cost nothing, and every two weeks a collector stops by the lake. The “Fish Market” purchase unlocks the Village Market, City Market, the monthly Fish Festival and New York, plus the whole Market Shop and the Ledger. Premium Bait and the Carbon Rod are also sold for thalers in the Market Shop.
• If you only want to fish, you won't notice the market at all.
• Long casts: hold a little longer to wind up and cast up to 100 m. Far out, rare fish bite more often, but reeling in takes longer. A tap casts as before.
• In a fight, the edge of the screen shows how tight the line is: the tighter it gets, the narrower your view. When the rod tip glows red, ease off.
• Every bait has its own float and every rod its own look. Premium Bait comes with a float that carries a diamond.

All your existing catches are kept. Tight lines!

New in 3.1:
• Once your Catch Log is complete, every species you've caught leaps out of the lake one more time. Everyday fish come first in a wave, then the rare ones, and the legends last.
• After that you get the Master Rod. It reels in like the Carbon Rod and finds variants twice as often, since they're what you still have left to find.
• The top of the Catch Log shows how many variants you have so far. You can also watch the lap of honour again from there.
• With Premium Bait, species you haven't caught yet bite a little more often.
• The species count on the lake and in the complications now includes the species from the chapters.

If you already had every species, the Master Rod is waiting for you when you open the app. The lap of honour follows your next catch.

All your existing catches are kept. Tight lines!

New in 3.2:
• On iPhone, the catch card now has a camera. It takes a photo of your character with the catch at the lake as it looks right now, with its light, weather and season. Share the photo or save it to your Photos.
• You hold small fish between two fingers and bigger ones in both hands. Anything too big hangs from a frame on the jetty. If one gets away, you still get a photo: It Was THIS Big.
• In the Catch Log you can take a photo with your record catch of any species, even one that bit on the watch.
• Before the first photo you put your character together: ten hairstyles, beards, glasses, build, freckles and more. It's all free, and the dice pick a face and build for you if you'd rather not choose.
• The Market Shop now sells clothes: five hats and five outfits, from a cap for 40 thalers to a suit for 2400. You don't need a purchase for them. You change in the Wardrobe next to the Tackle Box.
• While a market day runs, the Fish Market has a postcard from the road for you. Your character waves in front of the place you're selling at, with the stall, the weather and a greeting. You now fly to New York yourself.

All your existing catches are kept. Tight lines!

New in 3.3:
• Catch every species at the lake and you'll discover something new. If your Catch Log is already complete, the surprise is waiting right after the update.
• In the Tackle Box at the Fish Market, Premium Bait now tells you that less junk bites with it, and even less far out. If your Catch Log is still missing some junk, cast short.

All your existing catches are kept. Tight lines!

New in 3.4:
• The shop is new: each upgrade is a note pinned up in front of your lake, with a picture and a list of what it gives you. What you already own gets a stamp.
• Your character gets four head shapes and six new hairstyles, such as a side part, a quiff or slicked-back hair. You'll find them in the Wardrobe, and the dice know them too. A character you've already made stays as it is.
• Tap Save to keep changes to your character, or Cancel to leave it as it was. Your character stays in view while you scroll through hairstyles and hats.
• The catch photo slides out like an instant photo and slowly develops.
• In the photos, hats and sleeves sit better, and hands and boots are redrawn.
• In the Catch Log you can now also take a photo with a variant you've caught.
• Photos can now be shared to WhatsApp, where sending used to get stuck.
• The catch card now shows the fish in color, just like the Catch Log. The photo button sits below it and no longer covers any text. With large text, the line with rarity, length and weight fits on the card again.

All your existing catches are kept. Tight lines!
